# Service desk ticket INC1366

**From:** Cloud Security

The posture scanner reports several security-group rules open to the whole internet (`0.0.0.0/0`) in the production account. Remediate them according to the network standard and close the ticket with what you changed.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.
